text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a shadow probe that enables prefetch_window=32 for the prefix cache on node-group eu-west-2-g5? Seen a spike in evictions on pfx-shard-12 around 09:12 UTC. Want a microbench to compare hit_rate + inflight_prefetch_bytes. Not urgent but would like perf diffs to share with SRE.

tomas: I can run. Which workload and exact config? c10k or small_batch? Also do you want the kv-prefetch path or prefix-cohort prefetch?

maria: Use workload `pfx-load-regen` (same as yesterday), 10k requests, prod-ish seq_len distro. Command:
```
./run_shadow_probe --workload pfx-load-regen --nodes eu-west-2-g5 --shards 12 --prefetch_window 32 --out /tmp/shadow32.log 
--collect-metrics prefetch,hits,evictions
```
And please also capture `inflight_prefetch_bytes` and allocation profiles.

perf-bot: Scheduled shadow probe: run_id=sp-2100001234-1 started by @maria on eu-west-2-g5. ETA ~6m. Will post metrics when done.

jeff: @maria ping — I'll take this. Running now. I can also run baseline with prefetch_window=0 for diff.

lena: cc @jeff when done can you paste the top-level summary? Interested in hit_rate and p50 latency by model_step.

jeff: run finished. quick paste of metrics:
```
hit_rate_total: 0.72
evictions_per_min: 54
inflight_prefetch_bytes: 1.3GiB
p50_latency_ms: 18.4
p95_latency_ms: 42.1
```
Baseline (prefetch=0):
```
hit_rate_total: 0.60
evictions_per_min: 78
inflight_prefetch_bytes: 0.1GiB
p50_latency_ms: 20.1
p95_latency_ms: 45.9
```

maria: Nice — prefetch reduces evictions and improves p50. Can we get a quick heap diff / flame? I'm worried about hidden memory churn or short-lived allocations.

jeff: attached heap diff + flame id sp-2100001234-1-flame.png (uploaded). Quick glance: more short-lived allocs in allocator `kv_prefetcher` but overall RSS stable.

tomas: FYI PR #4123 changes prefetch backoff logic. @lena @maria can you review? If we merge, we should rerun a shadow with the backoff tweak.

lena: I'll review PR 4123 today. If it looks safe, prefer merging behind a canary on Dedicated and then rerun shadows.

maria: Thanks all. @jeff can you schedule a follow-up shadow with `prefetch_backoff=0.5` (and baseline) and attach the diffs to PR 4123? I'll include metrics in the incident notes.

jeff: Yup — will schedule and paste results here when done.
